Sentence (English): We have had a dishwasher from 1987 LOL but it was GE, for quite awhile now.
Comments (English): [ Love the features, but beeps and seems long? ] || ---------------- || We have had a dishwasher from 1987 LOL but it was GE, for quite awhile now. You had to turn the dial, and it was quite old. So this was quite an upgrade! The features on this thing, I don't even know how to use! I'm still learning and figuring it out as we go along and boy does it get the dishes clean. Which is the point, and which is why this gets a 4 stars. However it doesn't get 5 stars because I'm a little frustrated with the manual for one. It doesn't tell me how to use the features. Like the cup holder, the top rack(which should be obvious to some who have had these new dishwashers- but I have no idea what to put up there lol). It tells me to go online, which I did, but once again, the website doesn't tell me either and it can be rather difficult to find where to go to get this information on the features and how to use them. Maybe the settings and it gives me that information- which is great. Loading a dishwasher should be obvious but when I have a 13 year old who normally loads the dishwasher- she needs assistance on this third rack and these other things that we've never seen before, and it doesn't explain it except when I see pictures and that's what I can show her basically. It doesn't tell you though. Then how long it takes to wash the dishes- is that how long it usually takes to wash a load? I guess I never noticed before when we had a dishwasher that didn't have a timer on it, how long it took. And maybe I'm just thinking of laundry and the fact that a load of laundry only takes 30min to an hour but a load of dishes takes 3 hours? That seems long to me. and maybe it's only that one setting? It seems like ours has been doing 3 hours every time. I need to read the manual more and make sure we are doing the right setting. and every time we load the dishwasher with dirty dishes but not fully, so we aren't ready to start it yet, we have to make sure we cancel it because otherwise it will beep and beep at us. But maybe that's a good thing. Making sure we know it hasn't started yet. Our old one you would know it hasn't started yet because it was so LOUD but this one is quiet. A picture of our new dishwasher!

Sentence (English): We previously owned a Jenn-Air/Whirlpool for 10 years.
Comments (English): [ Mixed feelings ] || ---------------- || We previously owned a Jenn-Air/Whirlpool for 10 years. We transitioned to Bosch based on reviews and independent stores telling us how the quality is the best in the industry. Right away, we were disappointed. 1. It is noisy. Our old dishwasher was rated a 40, this one a 42. I had no idea how much impact 2 decibels would make. Is Bosch SURE it's rated at 42? Was Jenn-Air better than 40? 2. The door is flimsy and flexes. When we open using any area on the handle other then dead center, it's visible how much the door rotates. 3. The stainless steel front piece is impossible to keep clean. It's obviously not as good of quality as our JennWhirl. 4. The loading pattern is awful. I recognize it will take time to get used to the new racks, but we can only fit one large item on the bottom because the tines are too close together. We've figured out large items fit better on the top, but it's still less capacity than what we had before. I wonder if it would have made a difference to bump up to the next better series of Bosch? Either way, I sure hope I don't have to find out before 10 years are up because that's how long I expect this dishwasher to last given all of the hype.

Sentence (English): Does a great job of cleaning dirty dishes - more so than our old GE Profile, which was really good and still working well but not perfectly clean when you put in dishes with heavy food stains.
Comments (English): Does a great job of cleaning dirty dishes - more so than our old GE Profile, which was really good and still working well but not perfectly clean when you put in dishes with heavy food stains. It's been about a week with the Kitchen Aid 604 and so far it's impressive. Always clean dishes, regardless of how dirty they were when the cycle starts. I've been putting in extra dirty plates and glasses to test it and so far I'm impressed - all clean. The real reason for choosing this model is for the top rack, which is really nice to have such great extra room! It holds about six glasses and small odds and ends (tiny bowls, serving utensils, etc.) and some silverware (enough for a couple meals for two people). This "third rack" is really a key selling point and differentiator. If not we might have gone with a higher end brand, but nothing out there has such a large top rack, so Kitchen Aid seems to have done it right. You can fit a lot of dirty dishes in all three racks, so it seems to hold a lot! I'm still learning what to put where within the machine but a this point I'm impressed with the room. Importantly, the 604 also allows you to run the top two racks alone - so you don't need to wait to fill the whole machine up to run a load. This was the other key selling point for us. And that works well too! The run cycle is very quiet, and you don't even notice that it's running. It's a bit long, over two hours, but that's fine for us. At the end it says "CLEAN" on the screen, which is also very nice! No need for the old magnetic sign that we used to flip from Dirty to Clean every time we ran the old machine. I pondered giving this machine 4 stars because at the end of the day it's just a good dishwasher and it doesn't do anything extra special. but for what it offers for the price of the machine it's a solid purchase. We'll see how it lasts over time, but the shelves are sturdy inside and it seems well-built.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher was terrific when we first installed it.
Comments (English): [ Major problems early on and terrible product support ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was terrific when we first installed it. Unlike other reviewers, I didn't even have problems with it not drying dishes. It cleaned even grimy dishes and the Sensor wash worked well. (The sensor cycle takes a while, but we usually run it at night anyway.) Also, it was quiet, so we could run it at night. Fast forward to two years later (just when we're outside of the manufacturer's warranty) it's leaking, it sometimes cleans the dishes, sometimes doesn't. It actually belches grimy water back into itself. Some of the cleaning issues have been resolved by taking parts out and scrubbing them, but that doesn't explain the leaking from the front of the machine (which is only getting worse.). Also, this is AIG, not Whirlpool, but Whirlpool uses AIG for their extended warranties---do not buy the extended warranty. It is completely worthless. I misplaced the original paper and they sent me a renewal, but now they're claiming that I don't have a policy on file to renew (which means they either don't have their stuff together or it's a scam. Based on the BBB reviews, I'm going with scam.). Another problem we had with this dishwasher, again just past one year of ownership, was the top rack broke. At least that was an easy thing to fix, but considering that this is not supposed to be an apartment grade dishwasher, stuff like that really shouldn't happen.

Comments (English): [ Great Performance, just don't get Black Stainless! ] || ---------------- || Picked this up as a display model. Install was a little more difficult due to having to acquire some parts that would normally be included. Cleaning performance is very good so far, and drastically quieter than the 10+ year old unit I replaced. The only negative is the black stainless, it looks really good but it's very fragile. As a display model it had a magnetic sign on it that left marks on the face that seem to be permanent. If I'd paid full price I'd be very annoyed at the ease of ruining the black stainless finish. Do some googling and black stainless gets similar complaints across all models, not just kitchenaid.

Sentence (English): Get the 800 series that my son and daughter-in-law have.
Comments (English): [ Repulsive odor & wet dishes ] || ---------------- || Get the 800 series that my son and daughter-in-law have. It is great. Do not waste your money on the 500 Series. Due to the noxious odor, I thoroughly rinse all dishes and utensils before loading. I clean the filter daily. When I do not have a full load, I put it through a rinse only cycle. Nothing stops the nauseating odor. The sprayer arm remains filled with water at the end of every cycle even though I have the unit set to "Auto Air" for every wash. The slighest bump dumps the water left in the sprayer arm onto the dishes, so you have to hand dry. I have read the manual completely and have read online suggestions like adding a cup of 50% white vinegar and 50% water. The result is a thinly-veiled attempt at masking the odor with the vinegar smell. Save a little longert and get the 800 series. The only reason I purchased the 500 was that the waiting period for the 8-- series was too long.

Sentence (English): I bought it on Friday and installed it today, Tuesday, over the weekend.
Comments (English): [ Don't expect it to dry out ] || ---------------- || I bought it on Friday and installed it today, Tuesday, over the weekend. I bought it for around 650,000 won with a card discount from the Wow member price of around 680,000 won. The price has now gone up to 900,000 won. In terms of price, buying a 12-person Samsung brand dishwasher for around 600,000 won is very cost-effective and satisfactory. It is a whole new world after actually using it. Comments (Original): [ 건조는 기대하지마시길 ] || ---------------- || 금요일 구매 후 주말끼어서 화요일 오늘 설치 완료하였음.  월요일 기사님 오셔서 싱크대 빌트인 리폼 공사 하셨고 규격장크기가 아니라 +9만원 추가 비용 발생됨.  다음날 삼성기사 방문설치완료.  주말 제외 2일만에 받아본거라 배송면에선 만족도 높음.  와우회원가 68만원대에서 카드 할인 받아 65만원대에 구매하였음.  지금은 90만원대로 가격이 올라있음.  가격적인면에서 60만원대에 12인용 삼성 브랜드 식세기구입은 아주 가성비있고 만족스러움.  실사용해보니 신세계.  장점이 엄청 많음.  단점은 건조가 다 안된다는점.  물기가 많이 묻어나옴.  이외 단점 찾아볼수없음.

Sentence (English): Just got this dishwasher installed yesterday and we are so happy with our purchase!
Comments (English): [ Impressed with loading capacity! ] || ---------------- || Just got this dishwasher installed yesterday and we are so happy with our purchase! We wanted a dishwasher that still had the option to use heated dry, as we don't like to let our dishes air dry. It does amazing on drying everything except for plastics. The only downfall is that the washing cycles take forever with all of these newer dishwashers. Luckily, with the large capacity of this dishwasher it is tolerable. We can fit two 8 quart instant pot inserts (with the handles), dishes and the silverware rack in the bottom rack, wow! We did have an issue with the installer trying to charge us $120 to install an outlet. He claimed it was only able to be plugged in and was not a hardwired dishwasher. I was skeptical, so I demanded to see the plug. He just had to remove the plug to hardwire it by untwisting the wires. I realized he was trying to make a quick buck off of us. Just be cautious with the installation if you plan to use Costco services or have someone at your house who knows better. Overall, dishes are squeaky clean and it is so quiet! The third rack is a nice touch and love the stainless steel tub. Can't go wrong with this purchase for the price. Especially if it is on sale like it was for Memorial Day!

Sentence (English): It's fortunate I purchased this dishwasher on sale, because if I had paid full price, I would be even more disappointed and maybe a bit angry with the performance of the machine for the price paid.
Comments (English): [ GE dishwasher doesn't really ] || ---------------- || It's fortunate I purchased this dishwasher on sale, because if I had paid full price, I would be even more disappointed and maybe a bit angry with the performance of the machine for the price paid. Let me start out relating that regardless of the washing cycle chosen, along with any additional cycle options one might be able to add, and regardless of whether powder, liquid, or gel pack dish detergent is used, this machine does not reliably and consistently clean dirty dishes, pots, pans, drinkware, cutlery and other utensils. I have tried a myriad of different cycle and detergent combinations, as well as combinations for loading/stacking the dishwasher in varying ways. Since no combination whatsoever has given reliably good results, I realize it is the failure of the machine to do the job required of it. Is it a design feature? At least in part, yes. Particular emphasis was placed on the attention that is given to cutlery rack cleaning, and yet cutlery placed in the cutlery rack always falls short of clean. Perhaps this is because cutlery placed in it must always be pointing upwards instead of toward the flow of the water jet unless the cutlery basket top is left open, and the cutlery is loaded into it in a manner that would not keep them separate. This machine does have a "third" rack. And except for a few flat style cooking utensils, it's basically useless and actually an annoyance. Any ladle of decent size, simply won't fit on it, nor any decent sized manual potato masher, etc etc. And the handles of such items won't fit into the slots of the cutlery basket, so onto the second rack they go taking up valuable real estate. Additionally, the "third" rack limits the size of drinkware that can be placed onto the second rack even with the height adjustability of the second rack. Because adjusting the height of the second rack obviously then limits the height of items that can be loaded onto the bottom rack. Further, it is more than likely that the machine's low water usage is responsible for it's poor cleaning performance. And finally, despite usage of a spot reducer/drying enhancement liquid, and choosing drying boosting options on the machine, never have any of the loads of dishes emerged dry or anywhere even close.

For all of you out there in 'appliance land', my wife and I are very satisfied with the new BOSCH 500 Series unit. For us, the usual, the simple straight forward installation turned out to be a 2 day affair with 7 billable plumbing hours. The original dishwasher to be removed had solid copper piping and valving which protruded into the space allowed for the new Bosch unit; this was all removed, capped and we were lucky enough to have an additional hot water connection at the kitchen sink to use. The 120v power connection, which is a dedicated circuit, turned out to be wires twisted together and only 1 Mar Connector; we installed a new terminal box and plug. 'Ready to go' - no power! It turns out that the electrical breaker in our fuse panel had decided to retire - so we installed a new breaker and Voila, a fully operational BOSCH Dishwasher. My reason for ever bringing up the installation is that dispite the excellence of the product you must do your homeword and check on the space requirements and mechanical/electrical connection status. The 500 Series Dishwasher is a great machine; we now have 2 of them and it is great to know that the connections are building code compliant.

Sentence (English): I did a lot of research before buying this dishwasher and was excited to buy a Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Not really happy ] || ---------------- || I did a lot of research before buying this dishwasher and was excited to buy a Bosch. I have had a Frigidaire for almost 14 years and it finally gave up. I am so disappointed in the internal organization of this dishwasher. I have a large family and the space in this model does not measure up to the Frigidaire. The top rack won't fit half of my glasses so I have to stradle the tines. Trying to fit regular dishes with a larger dish or pot is so frustrating. On the plus side, It cleans well and is very quiet but every time I load it is an exercise in frustration. The silverware bin is quite small. I guess they expect you to put most of it on the third rack but I put my large utensils up there. I never imagined that the "same size" dishwasher would hold so much less.

Sentence (English): I just wanted a reliable dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Busted after only 2 years! ] || ---------------- || I just wanted a reliable dishwasher. That's why I splurged on a Bosch. But 2 years and 1 week after I purchased this dishwasher, it stopped working and gave an error code for an internal leak. The Bosch-certified repairman told me it was leaking from the main pump and wasn't worth trying to fix as it would require a major overhaul and likely would still leak. He wasn't even willing to give me a quote. So now I have it pulled out from under the counter so that I can change the towels out from under it with every load to keep things dry and keep the sensor from triggering and stopping it mid-cycle. I do that because it's still easier than handwashing dishes when you have a big family, but this is so not the reliable dishwasher I was hoping for when I bought a Bosch!

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher works fine, but I wouldn't buy it again ] || ---------------- || This review is going to look silly and nitpicky to people browsing for a new dishwasher. I know this because the similar reviews I read looked that way to me, so much so that I just ignored them and bought it anyway (whoops). The issue with this dishwasher is that it's REALLY, REALLY easy to accidentally turn on - especially if you're installing it in a high-traffic area of your kitchen. And this is because the on/off mechanism is a touch-screen rather than an actual button. The first time it happened, we were like oh huh that's funny. After the first few weeks of accidentally turning this thing on like 6 times a day (every time we used the kitchen counter), it gets old pretty quickly. And TBH if we had to do it again, we'd opt for a similar model from another vendor that has an actual button - not a touchscreen triggered by any passing, very slightly grazing contact. I'm afraid I'm going to burn this mechanism out in 5 years.

Sentence (English): My old dishwasher was super noisy, didn't get everything clean, and didn't get anything dry.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || My old dishwasher was super noisy, didn't get everything clean, and didn't get anything dry. The Bosch 800 series is great - it's so incredibly quiet! It gets stuff pretty clean, and does a better job drying (with Crystal Dry setting) vs. our old one. The 3rd rack for silverware, spatulas, etc. is a game changer! Overall pretty happy. Downsides: some items don't get dry, especially plastic or anything with an indentation that catches water, and that's disappointing given we upgraded from 500 to 800 series for the Crystal Dry option. Also we have noticed the countertop above the dishwasher gets warm when it runs, and our quartz countertop installer said not to leave a drying mat or anything else covering the counter above the dishwasher as trapped heat can damage it over time. One final minor complaint: lighter plastic items tend to get knocked around and end up collecting water because the jets are quite strong, so we have ended up hand washing some lighter items.

Sentence (English): I have been using the dishwasher for two weeks and these are my conclusions: 1 - Baskets: They are very practical.
Comments (English): [ Cleaning and Drying for perfect crockery ] || ---------------- || I have been using the dishwasher for two weeks and these are my conclusions: 1 - Baskets: They are very practical. Contains 3 baskets. A superior one for cutlery, which at first costs a bit to use, but when you organize it by spoons, forks, knives, etc., it is very practical since when I take out the cutlery I already have them organized to easily put them in the drawer. An intermediate one for glasses, tuppers and small objects. This basket contains two positions, one higher and one lower so that if you add tall things, either in this basket or in the lower one, they can enter without hitting the blades of the dishwasher. I think this option is great and it's super easy to use, having finger-shaped handles that make it easy to change the position. A lower basket, which does not contain a cutlery basket (it has its area in the upper basket), which gives it plenty of space for dishes or, if you fold the skewers, for objects such as saucepans, paella pans (I have tried it and ten). 2.- Programs, it has a variety of programs: Eco, Rinse, Delicate, Auto, so you can choose according to the content you are going to wash. I usually use Eco, although the program is longer, I like the option to save energy and water. To this program I add the Steam option so that the glasses come out shiny. And indeed they come out clear and without stains. And the best thing for me is that at the end of the program the door opens to finish drying the dishes! This is great. 3.- Lime Regulation Option: This option is the one I liked the most. It makes your dishwasher use more or less salt depending on your geographical area, which you have to tell it at the beginning of use, so that it softens the water and is no longer hard, which avoids annoying traces of lime. I live in the area hard water, it's perfect for me. 4.- Program Download Option: It comes with the option of downloading an APP to manage the dishwasher from your mobile. The useful thing about this application is that it tells you the number of washes you have and when to clean the tub. It also contains options such as program delay to choose when it ends. Disadvantage: It is too tactile and sensitive, which is why I, who have small children, always have to lock the dishwasher control so that they do not modify anything. Of course, it is appreciated that it has a Screen Lock.
Comments (Original): [ Limpieza y Secado para una vajilla perfecta ] || ---------------- || Llevo dos semanas utilizando el lavavajillas y estas son mis conclusiones: 1 - Cestos: Son muy prácticos. Contiene 3 cestos. Uno superior para cubiertos, que al principio cuesta un poco de utilizar, pero cuando lo organizas por zona cucharas, tenedores, cuchillos etc es muy práctico ya que al sacar los cubiertos ya los tengo organizados para meter al cajón fácilmente. Uno intermedio para vasos, tuppers y objetos pequeños. Este cesto contiene dos posiciones, uno más alto y otro más bajo para si añades cosas altas, bien en esta cesta o en la inferior, que pueda entrar sin golpear en las aspas del lavavajillas. Esta opción me parece genial y es super fácil de usar, al tener unas asas con forma de dedos que lo hace sencillo de cambiar la posición. Un cesto inferior, que no contiene cesto de cubiertos (tiene su zona en el cesto superior), lo que le da un montón de espacio para platos o bien si pliegas los pinchos, para objetos como cacerolas, paelleras (yo lo he probado y de diez). 2.- Programas, tiene variedad de programas: Eco, Aclarado, Delicado, Auto, para que elijas según el contenido que vayas a lavar. Yo suelo usar Eco que aunque es más largo el programa me gusta la opción de ahorro de energía y agua. A este programa le añado la opción Vapor para que los vasos salgan relucientes. Y efectivamente salen claros y sin manchas. Y lo Mejor para mí, es que al final del programa la puerta se abre para que se termine de secar la vajilla!! Esto es genial. 3.- Opción Regulación de Cal: Esta opción es la que más me ha gustado. Hace que tu lavavajillas use más o menos sal en función de tu zona geográfica, que tienes que indicarle al principio del uso, para que ablande el agua y ya no sea dura, lo que evita los molestos restos de Cal. Yo que vivo en zona de agua dura, es perfecto para mí. 4.- Opción Descarga de Programas: Viene con opción de bajar una APP para gestionar el lavavajillas desde tu móvil. De esta aplicación lo útil es que te indica el número de lavados que llevas y cuando limpiar la cuba. Además contiene opciones cómo retardo de programas para elegir cuando termina. Inconveniente: Es demasiado táctil y sensible, por lo que yo que tengo niños pequeños tengo que bloquear siempre el mando del lavavajillas para que no me modifiquen nada. Eso sí es de agradecer que tiene Bloqueo de Pantalla.

A superior one for cutlery, which at first costs a bit to use, but when you organize it by spoons, forks, knives, etc., it is very practical since when I take out the cutlery I already have them organized to easily put them in the drawer. An intermediate one for glasses, tuppers and small objects. This basket contains two positions, one higher and one lower so that if you add tall things, either in this basket or in the lower one, they can enter without hitting the blades of the dishwasher. I think this option is great and it's super easy to use, having finger-shaped handles that make it easy to change the position. A lower basket, which does not contain a cutlery basket (it has its area in the upper basket), which gives it plenty of space for dishes or, if you fold the skewers, for objects such as saucepans, paella pans (I have tried it and ten). 2.- Programs, it has a variety of programs: Eco, Rinse, Delicate, Auto, so you can choose according to the content you are going to wash. I usually use Eco, although the program is longer, I like the option to save energy and water. To this program I add the Steam option so that the glasses come out shiny. And indeed they come out clear and without stains. And the best thing for me is that at the end of the program the door opens to finish drying the dishes! This is great. 3.- Lime Regulation Option: This option is the one I liked the most. It makes your dishwasher use more or less salt depending on your geographical area, which you have to tell it at the beginning of use, so that it softens the water and is no longer hard, which avoids annoying traces of lime. I live in the area hard water, it's perfect for me. 4.- Program Download Option: It comes with the option of downloading an APP to manage the dishwasher from your mobile. The useful thing about this application is that it tells you the number of washes you have and when to clean the tub. It also contains options such as program delay to choose when it ends. Disadvantage: It is too tactile and sensitive, which is why I, who have small children, always have to lock the dishwasher control so that they do not modify anything. Of course, it is appreciated that it has a Screen Lock.
Comments (Original): [ Limpieza y Secado para una vajilla perfecta ] || ---------------- || Llevo dos semanas utilizando el lavavajillas y estas son mis conclusiones: 1 - Cestos: Son muy prácticos. Contiene 3 cestos. Uno superior para cubiertos, que al principio cuesta un poco de utilizar, pero cuando lo organizas por zona cucharas, tenedores, cuchillos etc es muy práctico ya que al sacar los cubiertos ya los tengo organizados para meter al cajón fácilmente. Uno intermedio para vasos, tuppers y objetos pequeños. Este cesto contiene dos posiciones, uno más alto y otro más bajo para si añades cosas altas, bien en esta cesta o en la inferior, que pueda entrar sin golpear en las aspas del lavavajillas. Esta opción me parece genial y es super fácil de usar, al tener unas asas con forma de dedos que lo hace sencillo de cambiar la posición. Un cesto inferior, que no contiene cesto de cubiertos (tiene su zona en el cesto superior), lo que le da un montón de espacio para platos o bien si pliegas los pinchos, para objetos como cacerolas, paelleras (yo lo he probado y de diez). 2.- Programas, tiene variedad de programas: Eco, Aclarado, Delicado, Auto, para que elijas según el contenido que vayas a lavar. Yo suelo usar Eco que aunque es más largo el programa me gusta la opción de ahorro de energía y agua. A este programa le añado la opción Vapor para que los vasos salgan relucientes. Y efectivamente salen claros y sin manchas. Y lo Mejor para mí, es que al final del programa la puerta se abre para que se termine de secar la vajilla!! Esto es genial. 3.- Opción Regulación de Cal: Esta opción es la que más me ha gustado. Hace que tu lavavajillas use más o menos sal en función de tu zona geográfica, que tienes que indicarle al principio del uso, para que ablande el agua y ya no sea dura, lo que evita los molestos restos de Cal. Yo que vivo en zona de agua dura, es perfecto para mí. 4.- Opción Descarga de Programas: Viene con opción de bajar una APP para gestionar el lavavajillas desde tu móvil. De esta aplicación lo útil es que te indica el número de lavados que llevas y cuando limpiar la cuba. Además contiene opciones cómo retardo de programas para elegir cuando termina. Inconveniente: Es demasiado táctil y sensible, por lo que yo que tengo niños pequeños tengo que bloquear siempre el mando del lavavajillas para que no me modifiquen nada. Eso sí es de agradecer que tiene Bloqueo de Pantalla.

Sentence (English): I got this dishwasher to replace a GE I'd had for 16 years.
Comments (English): [ Very happy with this one! ] || ---------------- || I got this dishwasher to replace a GE I'd had for 16 years. That dishwasher was perfect, so I had very high standards when looking for a replacement. I got this dishwasher with a little hesitancy, but have used it for 2 months and am very, very happy with it. It cleans well, dries great, is incredibly quiet and I can't get over how many dishes I can get in it. The only thing I would change about this dishwasher is to make the 3rd rack the deepest depth throughout. Much of the 3rd rack is shallow allowing for regular utensils. I have no use for that since the utensil basket is nice size. Two recommendations if you get this dishwasher. One, leave the door slightly ajar if you aren't going to be running it every day. The door closes tightly and I figure it's not a good idea to put dirty dishes into a "sealed" place for days until I run it. Also, it dries the dishes very well, but the walls of the dishwasher will be wet for a long time. My solution if you're not running it every day, run the dishwasher after dinner (takes 3 hours to run), open the door and pull the racks out to some degree before going to bed. The dishes are dry and the walls are dry too. In the end, I highly recommend this dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher but be careful for door front! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher does a fantastic job cleaning and drying the dishes, and also in quietness. The only problem is it is supposed to come with a white glass door front. The delivery and installation did have an issue, Costco & Samsung got that resolved. Our white glass door front was not white but a light grey. Since we were leaving for our Florida home There was nothing that could be done about it. Upon returning back to our Ohio house, I contacted Costco and they took my report and then transferred me to Samsung and was pretty quickly told that I would need to pay for a service call and also for the correct door front. I feel this is totally wrong as the error lies with them.
